phrase_triggers.reminder: The operator is referencing prior-session context ("I told you" / "as I said" / "I mentioned"). The information they're calling out is almost certainly in memory/ — most likely memory/about-me.md, memory/relationships/<name>.md, or the most recent 2-3 sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.md files. Your FIRST tool call MUST be a grep across those for the topic they're referencing. Don't ask them to repeat info — find what they already said and read it. If after the grep you genuinely can't locate it, ask exactly ONE specific question naming where you looked.
